pokedexEntries.su: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

pokedexEntries.mo: It battles skillfully with its six arms, but spends most of its time peacefully meditating in caves deep beneath the sea.

pokedexEntries.us: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.

pokedexEntries.um: Its claws, which it can extend and retract at will, are its greatest weapons. Golisopod is sometimes accompanied by Wimpod.

pokedexEntries.sw: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

pokedexEntries.sh: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

pokedexEntries.za: It has the skill to cleave even air or seawater in two with a flash of its giant, sharp claws.
